title: Runner report (contract v2)
description: What the runner adds to a trial, never the adapter (docs/adapter-contract.md sections 5 and 7): the label, the proxy's usage, the exit status and the full logs. Uploaded with result.json and trace.jsonl.

label.description: agent: graded by end_state. infra:*: not a quality outcome; reported, never silently dropped. infra:config_error (D26): a harness_error whose LiteLLM status was 401, 403 or 404, or a 400 about the request setup (auth, an unknown model, a rejected parameter); never re-queued, and the experiment pauses. infra:provider_error: 429 or 5xx, re-queued once. infra:budget_net: a budget stop, never re-queued. infra:sim_error: the simulated client failed (result conversation.ended_by sim_error: its call failed, or its reply had no text), re-queued once.

end_state.description: Copied from result.json; null when there is no valid result.

signal.description: Set when the runner killed the process group.

leftover_processes.description: Processes still alive in the group after the adapter exited, then killed.

proxy_usage.description: LiteLLM's records for the trial's key (R10.9). Null when the trial did not go through the proxy, such as a unit test against the fake directly.

complete.description: True only when, after the runner's wait, LiteLLM's log held at least the calls the trial is known to have made with each of its keys (the agent's: the harness's own count; the simulator's: one per line of out/sim_replies.jsonl), at least SPEND_LOG_QUIET_S (7 s) had passed since the adapter exited, and no count had changed for 1.5 s. False when that could not be shown within 30 s: such a trial's counts, cost and trace are not trusted.

model_calls.description: Requests the harness sent to LiteLLM: one spend-log row each. A harness retry is an extra call here.

attempts.description: Requests LiteLLM sent to the provider for those calls, its own retries included (D16): each call's 1 + metadata.attempted_retries, and 0 for a call refused before routing (a budget stop).

retried_calls.description: Calls LiteLLM sent to the provider more than once (D16).

failed_calls.description: Calls that still failed after LiteLLM's retries.

files.description: Every file under /trial/out, for the upload manifest (section 10).

checks.description: The platform checks the runner wrote to checks.json after the trial (docs/adapter-contract.md section 12): whether the file validated, how many money amounts had no tool, client-file or user number behind them, and which of the task's required tools were not called. Optional, so reports from before 4 Nov stay valid. path is null when the checks could not run; their failure never changes the label.

amounts.description: D61: how many money amounts the replies hold. Absent before D61; null when the checks could not run.

derived_in_prose.description: D61: how many of them the checker verified only by recomputing them, i.e. written without a tool (checks.json derived_in_prose). The comparison reports it per arm. Absent before D61; null when the checks could not run.

missing_tools.description: Null when the task lists no required_tools.

truncated.description: True only if the log passed the 50 MB cap (section 10).
